name: Sarvottam Finvest Ltd
summary: Sarvottam Finvest Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. It provides financing, loans and advances, and inter-corporate deposits, as well as invests and trades in shares and securities. The company was formerly known as Barclays & Chartered Financial Services Limited and changed its name to Sarvottam Finvest Limited in August 2011. Sarvottam Finvest Limited was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Kolkata, India.
